quest.title: Meeting New People... and Foiling Some Bandits
quest.description: As you explore the lower levels of The Chasm, you discover Treasure Hoarders. If they think you'll let them do things as they please down here, then they've got another think coming!
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

talks.objective: Go to the campsite that has been occupied by Treasure Hoarders

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: The locking mechanism hasn't rusted away yet. In fact, it looks like it's been lubricated. Looks like someone maintained it even after the mine was sealed.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: The breech also looks whole... It's just that the safety is currently locked down.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What is he talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: The tunnels ahead were sealed using large rocks when the miners were dispersed... Looks like that's where we're going to need to use this cannon again.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: But without any shot, cannons, no matter how large, are useless. As such, we need to find ourselves some.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Hmph, don't say it like I didn't know that, Mr. Know-It-All.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: There's a store room nearby that should contain the cannon-shot. With any luck, not all of it was moved away when the miners were dismissed...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's head that way, then.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Let's go.

talks.objective: Clear out the Treasure Hoarders in the miner's camp

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: This is the place. *cough* Ugh, the gate's locked.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Looks like we'll need to use two keys at once to open the door... Oh come on, why are you Liyue people so conscientious about the silliest things?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Oh, cut the useless chatter... See that notice pasted next to the gate? If nothing else, that tells us that our cannonballs can be found within.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Well, that's one thing, but how do we know if the fuses have been well-preserved or not? I wouldn't get our hopes up just yet.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Oh, great — we have an optimist over here. Cut it with the quitter talk, would you?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: ...Seriously, what am I doing, listening to a Treasure Hoarder doubt us left and right?

choices.text: Clitopho does have a point here, actually...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly! Don't you two fight, alright?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Hmph, alright. Let's continue. Maybe Jinwu knows how to open this gate.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: We'll be pretty busy after it opens, too. We'll have to activate a signaling device to get the breech open.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Jinwu said that there should be an observation point for the demolitions team that overlooks the cannon and that we'll be able to adjust the signal from there, which will let us unlock the cannon from a safe distance.

choices.text: Either way, we need to get this gate open first.

talks.objective: Save the person trapped in a cage by the Treasure Hoarders

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Phew! Thank you for saving my life...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Wait a moment... I remember you! You're that Toclipho guy from back at the mine!

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Uh, what? No! That wasn't... I—I don't sell any fake medicines! I'm Clitopho, yes, but not the one that's into pharmaceuticals. No sir!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh. So the medicines you sold were fake?

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: What? No! Impossible! The medicines I sell are one-hundred-percent the real deal! I mean, you saw the miners! They drank it, and they felt great!

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: And didn't you say you were the non-pharmaceutical Clitopho?

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Ah, uh... Right, that was after my life selling medicines ended. And it all ended when that... when that Toclipho sold fakes under a false identity!

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: He sold fake medicines under a false name and ruined my reputation! That's right. That's why I swore off selling medicines forever!

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: And just as I was changing tacks, I was captured by that band of Treasure Hoarders...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: But yes, that charlatan is truly despicable...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup, he's a real piece of work, to want to trick those in the same business as him like that!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And so, what was the false name of this "Toclipho" again?

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Clitopho!

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Uh. No, wait. Clitopho isn't a fake name. It's a real one...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Doesn't that make "Toclipho" a fake name?

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: No... Wait, yes. Yes. He took my name falsely, so "Clitopho" is now a false name. We're clear now, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh... So "Toclipho" became a real name.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What a shame...

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: What's a shame?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: You nearly confessed without us having to try too hard.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Let's take him back up. The Millelith have a lot of questions for him, most likely.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Or we could deal with him right here and now.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: What?

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: Hey! This isn't the time for such jokes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, hehehe. Paimon thinks it's pretty funny.

dialogues.speaker: Clitopho
dialogues.text: B—But you're not laughing. And no, this isn't funny at all!

choices.text: You're right, actually — because we're about to get serious.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: W—Wait a moment! This isn't the time for an interrogation!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I don't know about you, but carrying a Treasure Hoarder you scared half to death around doesn't appeal to me one bit. Either way, let's take him back to the camp first.

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Hey, hey, hey! Take me along, would you? I'll be very useful to you! I mean, as you can see... I've been kicked out of the Treasure Hoarders...

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: So now I'm an upstanding citizen again, y'know?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, so that's what counts for "upstanding citizen" to you, huh...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: And what are your skills, again?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: And your explosives aren't fake, either?

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: No, they're for real this time!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: ...I'm not at liberty to include you on the team. As for how we should deal with you, Jinwu would be a better judge of that. But I guess she'll just hand you over to the Millelith.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: But we'll keep an eye on you. All Treasure Hoarders are not to be trusted, let alone someone who sells fake medicine...

response.speaker: Clitopho
response.text: Oh come on, I don't do that anymore!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, we know, we know! Let's go, shall we?

talks.objective: Go to the second occupied camp
Clear the Treasure Hoarders from the miner's camp
Examine the giant cannon in the depths of the tunnels
Go to the storehouse in which the cannonballs are stored
